content:
As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, MLS will return to Apple TV tomorrow, with multiple related features also launching simultaneously across platforms including Apple Maps, Apple Sports, and Apple Fitness+. Details are as follows.

MLS Returns to Apple TV

Apple is highlighting the strong return of MLS today, with six matches scheduled over the coming days:

July 17 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs Toronto FC (7:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Chicago Fire vs Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • St. Louis City SC vs Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Seattle Sounders vs Portland Timbers (10:30 PM Eastern Time)

July 18 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM Eastern Time)
  • LA Galaxy vs LAFC (10:15 PM Eastern Time)

To welcome the return of the regular season, Apple has announced a series of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The new episode features German football legend Thomas Müller, who "recounts his early struggles before fame and shares how he embraces the challenges of major life transitions."

Apple Music will also launch multiple exclusive playlists, personally curated by players including Real Salt Lake's Diego Luna and FC Cincinnati's Evander da Silva Ferreira, along with dedicated playlists for Eastern and Western Conference clubs such as the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, and Orlando City SC — a star-studded lineup.

On Apple Maps, Apple will launch "matchday guides carefully crafted by MLS clubs, as well as city tours personally recommended by players," helping users discover great spots to watch matches in the area, explore city highlights, popular restaurants, and detailed stadium information.

For users relying on the Apple Sports app, they can keep up with the latest league updates, including live scores, standings, match text commentary, lineups, and team statistics.

Finally, Apple stated:

MLS matches are now broadcast for free to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions worldwide, and Apple will also provide exclusive content throughout the season and exclusive viewing rights to marquee events including the playoffs.

For more information about Apple's coverage of the MLS return, please click here.

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month, or subscribe via the Apple One bundle. The platform features a host of popular series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, The Last Stop, and Silo.
